products.name: L'Ombre Liquid Herringbone Choker
products.shortDesc: Silky, flexible 925 sterling silver ribbon links that drape flush against the collarbone like liquid mercury.
products.description: An ode to sleek modernism and effortless glamour. The L'Ombre Liquid Herringbone Choker is handcrafted using precision interlocking flat ribbon links that create an astonishingly fluid, mirror-shine finish. Designed to contour smoothly around the collarbone without twisting or catching.
products.materials: Solid 925 Sterling Silver with anti-tarnish rhodium barrier coating.
products.dimensions: Length: 16 inches + 2-inch extender chain. Ribbon width: 4.2mm.
products.clasp: Hand-soldered lobster claw closure with engraved Avelune signature tag.
products.care: Store flat in your included velvet pouch. Polish with microfiber cloth after wear.
products.handcraftedBy: Master Jeweler Lucas Rey - Hand-aligned ribbon weave

products.name: Papillon Dual-Layer Chevron & Bead Anklet
products.shortDesc: Dual-strand architecture marrying sculpted chevron herringbone links with delicate satellite beads and a hand-cast butterfly charm.
products.description: Capturing the poetic movement of transformation, the Papillon Anklet showcases two complementary strands in one seamless piece. One strand features architectural chevron arrows, paired with a satellite bead chain culminating in an ethereal three-dimensional butterfly charm.
products.materials: Artisan Sterling Silver and hypo-allergenic stainless alloy core for everyday flex resilience.
products.dimensions: Length: 9 inches + 2.5-inch custom extension loop. Butterfly pendant: 16mm x 14mm.
products.clasp: Reinforced lobster clasp with teardrop adjustment links.
products.care: Water-resistant finish. Rinse with fresh water after ocean or pool wear.
products.handcraftedBy: Atelier Camille - Hand-cast talisman and hand-linked satellite beads

products.name: Éclipse Tri-Disc Beaded Bracelet
products.shortDesc: Smooth circular discs suspended between micro-polished ball beads catching ambient light with graceful subtlety.
products.description: The Éclipse Bracelet balances tactile beaded texture with three flat mirror-polished circular disc pendants that chime softly in motion. Engineered for comfortable all-day wear and stunning when stacked with cuffs or watchbands.
products.materials: 925 Sterling Silver plated brass with protective polymer micro-seal.
products.dimensions: Length: 6.75 inches + 1.5-inch extender chain. Disc diameter: 9.5mm.
products.care: Keep away from harsh perfumes and direct chemical solvents. Buff with soft cloth.
products.handcraftedBy: Artisan Maya Chen - Individually stamped & diamond-buffed discs

products.name: Soleil & Lune Evil Eye Artisan Bracelet
products.shortDesc: Artisanal half-and-half piece featuring vibrant yellow glass beads, protective evil eye, freshwater pearl, and smiling crescent moon charm.
products.description: A talisman of joy, protection, and celestial wonder. This asymmetric signature piece contrasts sunny yellow Japanese seed beads and an evil eye glass bead with a genuine natural freshwater pearl, continuing into an antique silver link chain with a smiling crescent moon talisman.
products.materials: Japanese Miyuki seed beads, handcrafted lampwork glass evil eye, natural baroque freshwater pearl, antique silver plated brass chain.
products.clasp: Sturdy lobster clasp with bead stop safety crimp.
products.care: Avoid submerging in hot water to preserve string tension and pearl luster.
products.handcraftedBy: Founder & Lead Artisan Valerie Noire - Hand-strung & wire-wrapped

products.name: Céleste Hammered Silver Cuff
products.shortDesc: Sculptural open cuff hand-hammered to reflect dappled light like rippling water.
products.description: Forged on a jeweler's anvil, each Céleste cuff features thousands of individual light-catching facets that produce a soft organic glow. Malleable enough to gently adjust for a tailored wrist fit.
products.materials: Recycled 925 Sterling Silver with matte satin interior.
products.dimensions: Width: 8mm. Inner circumference: 6.5 inches (flexible open cuff).
products.care: Wipe with jeweler's cloth. Store individually to prevent scuffs.
products.handcraftedBy: Artisan Lucas Rey - Anvil hammered & hand burnished

products.name: Aura Freshwater Pearl Minimalist Drop
products.shortDesc: A luminous hand-selected natural baroque pearl floating on an ultra-fine 18k white gold vermeil chain.
products.description: Each baroque pearl is grown naturally and possesses its own singular contour, iridescent luster, and character. Suspended on a whisper-thin diamond-cut silver cable chain that catches light with subtle radiance.
products.materials: Cultured AAA Baroque Freshwater Pearl (10-11mm) and 925 Sterling Silver cable chain.
products.care: Put on after lotions and perfumes. Gently clean with damp silk cloth.
products.handcraftedBy: Atelier Camille - Pearl hand-drilled and bail wire-wrapped

products.name: Serpentine Dainty Twisted Rope Anklet
products.shortDesc: Twisted French rope chain designed for effortless glint on sunlit strolls and evening wear.
products.description: Spun with tight diamond-cut helical twists, the Serpentine Anklet glimmers continuously from every perspective. Featherweight and smooth against skin, it never snags on delicate fabrics.
products.materials: Italian 925 Sterling Silver with anti-oxidation rhodium shield.
products.clasp: Lobster claw with reinforced jump ring.
products.care: Shower safe. Avoid harsh chlorine and sulfur hot springs.
products.handcraftedBy: Studio Atelier Paris - Hand-twisted link assembly

products.name: Astral Starburst Medallion Necklace
products.shortDesc: Intricately hand-engraved celestial compass talisman set with a shimmering central cubic zircon starlight.
products.description: An homage to antique maritime navigational pendants and celestial wanderers. Hand-etched starburst rays radiate outwards from a bezel-set faceted center stone, encased in an artisan coin rim.
products.materials: Heavy 925 Sterling Silver medallion with brilliant-cut conflict-free CZ stone.
products.care: Store in cool, dry velvet pouch. Buff gently with anti-tarnish polishing cloth.
products.handcraftedBy: Artisan Maya Chen - Hand-engraved starburst relief

reviews.author: Sophia Laurent
reviews.title: Literally looks like melted silver on skin
reviews.comment: I have worn this choker non-stop for 3 weeks! It lays so completely flat against my neck, never twists or kinks, and the mirror shine is breathtaking. Everyone asks me where I got it.

reviews.author: Maya J.
reviews.title: Incredible weight and quality
reviews.comment: The craftsmanship is top tier. You can immediately feel the difference compared to cheap fast fashion jewelry. Heavy, supple, and clasp is sturdy.

reviews.author: Camille V.
reviews.title: The butterfly charm is utterly enchanting
reviews.comment: The double strand detail is so genius. The chevron catches the sun and the butterfly has this lovely artisanal weight. It stayed on during my whole trip to Amalfi!

reviews.author: Isabella R.
reviews.title: The soft chime of the discs is calming
reviews.comment: The discs have a mirror shine that hasn't tarnished at all. Looks very high end layered with my watch.

reviews.author: Amira K.
reviews.title: Unique statement piece with true personality
reviews.comment: I love the contrast between the sunny yellow beads and the silver moon charm! The evil eye feels authentic and the freshwater pearl gives it such an expensive organic touch.
